description: This file defines various enumeration classes representing different preference options for an Android application. These enums include layout modes, theme modes, color schemes, sorting methods, backup strategies, date/time formats, media opening options, and other user preferences, each with associated resources and behaviors.

classes.name: LayoutMode
classes.description: Enumeration for selecting layout display modes (grid or list) in the app preferences.

classes.name: ThemeMode
classes.description: Enumeration for theme display modes, including system, dark, and light preferences.

classes.name: DarkThemeMode
classes.description: Enumeration for dark theme styles, such as standard and black.

classes.name: ColorScheme
classes.description: Enumeration for color scheme choices, including blue, red, yellow, green, pink, orange, purple, and system default, with support restrictions based on Android SDK version.

classes.name: SortMethod
classes.description: Enumeration for different sorting orders for notes based on title, creation date, or modification date.

classes.name: SortTagsMethod
classes.description: Enumeration for sorting tags similar to notes.

classes.name: SortNavdrawerNotebooksMethod
classes.description: Enumeration for sorting notebooks in the navigation drawer.

classes.name: BackupStrategy
classes.description: Enumeration for backup strategies including including files, keeping info, or keeping nothing.

classes.name: NoteDeletionTime
classes.description: Enumeration for different durations after which notes are deleted automatically.

classes.name: DateFormat
classes.description: Enumeration for various date formatting patterns.

classes.name: TimeFormat
classes.description: Enumeration for time formatting options.

classes.name: OpenMediaIn
classes.description: Enumeration for specifying where media should open: internal or external.

classes.name: ShowDate
classes.description: Enumeration to toggle showing date in notes.

classes.name: FontSize
classes.description: Enumeration for different font sizes in the editor.

classes.name: ShowFabChangeMode
classes.description: Enumeration to dictate the mode of floating action button (FAB) display.

classes.name: GroupNotesWithoutNotebook
classes.description: Enumeration for grouping notes that lack an associated notebook.

classes.name: MoveCheckedItems
classes.description: Enumeration for moving checked items.

classes.name: DefaultEditorMode
classes.description: Enumeration for setting default editor modes (view or edit).

classes.name: CloudService
classes.description: Enumeration for selecting cloud storage services.

classes.name: SyncMode
classes.description: Enumeration for synchronization modes, such as Wi-Fi or always.

classes.name: BackgroundSync
classes.description: Enumeration to enable or disable background synchronization.

classes.name: NewNotesSyncable
classes.description: Enumeration indicating if new notes are syncable by default.

classes.name: TrustSelfSignedCertificate
classes.description: Enumeration to trust self-signed SSL certificates.
